psychological_meaning: Violent Violet evokes feelings of mystery, intensity, and deep introspection. It combines the stability of blue with the energy of red, resulting in a color that can represent power, ambition, and even a touch of the unconventional. It is often associated with creativity and imagination but can also suggest a sense of unease or drama, depending on the context.
